issues.description: Interface name mismatch: the problem statement and template refer to an interface named 'Rideable' with an abstract method messageOnRide(), but the solution repository defines an interface named 'Mountable' (Mountable.java) and has classes Pig and Seal implement Mountable. Additionally, Rideable.java in the solution is empty. This inconsistent identifier naming (Rideable vs Mountable) creates a blocking structural inconsistency: students following the spec will implement/expect Rideable, but the provided solution code uses Mountable, and the empty Rideable.java in the solution will cause compilation/test failures or confusion about which interface to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the interface identifier across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename Mountable to Rideable in the solution and ensure Rideable.java declares the method signature String messageOnRide(); update Pig and Seal to implement Rideable (remove Mountable). Ensure Rideable.java contains the package declaration and the interface method. Alternatively (if keeping Mountable is intentional), update the problem statement and template to reference 'Mountable' instead of 'Rideable' and provide the correct method signature there. The first option (renaming Mountable->Rideable and populating Rideable.java) is recommended to match the UML and problem text.

issues.description: Concept: the interface representing animals that can be ridden (method messageOnRide()). Problem statement and template refer to this interface as 'Rideable' with abstract method messageOnRide(). In the solution repository the same concept is implemented as an interface named 'Mountable' (declared in Mountable.java) and Pig and Seal implement Mountable, while Rideable.java in the solution is empty. This mismatched identifier naming (Rideable vs Mountable) prevents a clear one-to-one mapping from the exercise description/template to the solution code and will confuse students trying to implement or understand the required interface.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution's Mountable interface to Rideable (create/rename file to src/de/tum/cit/ase/Rideable.java with method String messageOnRide()), update Pig.java and Seal.java to implement Rideable, and remove or replace the existing empty Rideable.java in the solution. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to use 'Mountable' everywhere, but ensure only one identifier is used and the corresponding interface file is non-empty.
